correctness.rationale: Exact arc-set face enumerations and Hasse DAG checks establish the discrete-Morse CW cell descriptions for each of N=4,5,6. For N=4 the only triangles are the two disjoint tetrahedral boundaries, with exactly four bridging edges. For N=5 and N=6, distinct coherent-cycle fundamental cycles exhaust both top-dimensional Morse cells. At N=5 this gives zero degree attaching maps. At N=6 the explicit seven-term integral 2-cocycle has nonzero mod-two reduction and zero Alexander–Whitney square on every 4-simplex, forcing both Hopf coefficients to vanish because H4 is torsion free; thus both 4-cell attachments are null. Boundary cases, indexing conventions, acyclicity and signed computations are captured by the standalone verifier. No conclusion for other cycle lengths is made.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary study explicitly asks for the wedge-of-spheres homotopy classification of bidirectional polygon multipath complexes but supplies only homology. Resolving the initial three nontrivial cases is a motivated finite cutoff, and the six-vertex case requires a genuinely new unstable attaching-map obstruction calculation: zero differentials cannot rule out Hopf maps. The exact elementary construction and 7-supported integral cochain create a reusable, meaningful test for future all-parameter methods; the result is not a renaming, routine Betti recomputation, or an arbitrary slice.
